aboutGame.title: What is Flipping is Hard?
paragraphs: Flipping is Hard is a precision physics platformer from Elegant Horse Studios. You control Flippy, a legless phone who rotates, vibration-jumps, and tumbles across ten surreal climb areas on a journey to reunite with Jeff.

Every jump is built around momentum and timing rather than a walk button. Play solo with optional Chill Mode checkpoints, bring up to 16 friends into online co-op, chase 16 NPC challenges, unlock phone cosmetics and retro mini-games, or use quick restarts and built-in splits for speedruns.

modules.name: Flipping is Hard Beginner Guide
modules.description: Introduce the core gameplay, rotation-only movement, vibration jumps, basic climbing techniques, and ways to recover from mistakes. Help new players understand the difficulty and learn how to progress through the game’s surreal areas.

highlights.detail: Start in Chill Mode and land ten neutral jumps on wide platforms before adding rotation.
Add one short flip at a time and finish with the phone flat before chaining the next hop.
Recenter the camera axis before takeoff so a tilted horizon does not distort launch angle.
Repeat one clean route three times in a row before switching to Hard mode.

modules.name: Flipping is Hard Level Walkthrough
modules.description: Provide area-by-area progression tips for the ten surreal climbing areas, highlighting difficult obstacles, safe landing spots, and common causes of falling. Organize walkthrough content around in-game level layouts and player discoveries.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Final net and floating wood: launch from the side beam, then use Wall Jump B across the last gap.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Upper climb sections: angled wall contacts and narrow landings reward consistent Wall Jump B timing.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Mid-run sections: spring jumps and corner jumps add the height or distance needed to clear gaps.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Opening areas: wide platforms let you build neutral jumps and short rotations before the route tightens.

modules.name: Flipping is Hard Controls and Movement
modules.description: Explain the rotation-based movement system, vibration jumps, controller support, and practical input techniques for precise platforming. Include beginner-friendly movement tips to help players control momentum and avoid unnecessary falls.

highlights.label: ROTATE
highlights.detail: Rotate the phone body to build momentum; Flipping is Hard has no walk input.

highlights.label: JUMP
highlights.detail: A short vibration hop gains height; wait out the roughly quarter-second cooldown between presses.

highlights.label: AIR JUMP
highlights.detail: Spend a midair jump to extend an arc, recover a miss, or convert a wall touch.

highlights.label: CAMERA
highlights.detail: Recenter before takeoff and steer in the air; any solid surface contact resets the jump.

modules.name: Flipping is Hard Speedrun Guide
modules.description: Introduce speedrun-friendly features, quick restarts, built-in splits, and techniques for improving climbing consistency. Compare route categories and share time-saving movement strategies for cleaner runs.

highlights.detail: Learn the short jump cooldown so buffered presses are not eaten during a route.
Drill neutral high jumps and Wall Jump B until each contact is repeatable.
Use quick restarts and built-in splits to time clean route attempts.
Cut recovery time by steering in the air and chaining solid surface contacts.

faq.title: Flipping is Hard FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about Flipping is Hard.

items.question: What is Flipping is Hard?
items.answer: Flipping is Hard is a precision physics platformer from Elegant Horse Studios. You control Flippy, a legless phone who rotates and vibration-jumps through ten surreal climb areas to reunite with Jeff.

items.question: Does Flipping is Hard support co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Flipping is Hard supports online co-op for up to 16 players, with proximity chat plus shared beams and microwaves for helping teammates climb.

items.question: Does Flipping is Hard have checkpoints?
items.answer: Flipping is Hard offers an optional Chill Mode with checkpoints enabled. Standard play keeps the full challenge without that safety net.

items.question: How long is Flipping is Hard?
items.answer: A Chill Mode run through Flipping is Hard takes roughly 3 to 6 hours. Completionists report spending 20 to 50 hours on challenges, cosmetics, and clean runs.

items.question: Does Flipping is Hard have speedrun tools?
items.answer: Flipping is Hard includes quick restarts and built-in splits, so players can practice routes and time runs without an external timer.

items.question: How many NPC challenges are in Flipping is Hard?
items.answer: Flipping is Hard includes 16 optional NPC challenges spread across the ten climb areas.

items.question: Does Flipping is Hard have codes?
items.answer: Flipping is Hard codes include light_blue, dumb_phone, and flippy_the_phone. Open the in-game Codes, Extras, or Redeem menu and enter each string exactly.
